content: Kyaamwe, nikarora ekitabhu mukubhoko kwo obhuryo kwa wuno yiikeeri kukituumbi kyo omuriinga. Ekitabhu kiyo kyaari kikaamirwe mbaara zyoosi ibhiri, kweeki kyaari kibhohirwe ebhikuundiko muhuungati.
Kweeki nikarora maraika wo obhunagya bhukuru akuraarika kwe eriiraka ikuru, akabhuurya, “Ni weewi akweenderwa kungʼaarura ebhikuundiko no okukuundukura ekitabhu kino?”
Nawe ataabhonekeeni muutu naabhe mwiisaaro eyo, naabhe mukyaaro, naabhe nyaari wuno yaari akweenderwa kukikuundukura no okukisoma.
Ambe, nikataanga okurira bhukongʼu, kwo okubha ataabhonekeeni wowoosi wuno akweenderwa kukikuundukura ekitabhu kiyo naabhe okukisoma.
Niho owumwe wa abhakaruka bharya akaanibhuurira, “Tiga kurira! Rora! Endwi ye ekisyooko kya Yuuda,
orwiibhuro rwa Daudi, ahiziri. Ewe niwe akweenderwa kungʼaarura ebhikuundiko muhuungati mukitabhu kiyo no okukikuundukura.”

yiimeereeri hayo haguhi ne ekituumbi kyo omuriinga. Neewe yaari yiinogoorirwe ne ebhityeenyi bhine bhirya bhyo obhuhoru na abhakaruka bharya miroongo ebhiri na bhane (24), yaari ararorekana kya hano agwaagirwe. Na yaari ne eziiheembe muhuungati na ameeso muhuungati. Ameeso gayo ni koro muhuungati zya Taatabhugya zino zyaari zirageenwe mukyaaro kyoosi.
Engʼoondu wuyo, akagya akagega ekitabhu kirya okurwa mukubhoko kwo obhuryo kwa wuno yaari yiikeeri kukituumbi kyo omuriinga.

Hano yaagegiri ekitabhu kiyo, ebhityeenyi bhine na abhakaruka bharya bhakamugweera mumaguru. Bhoosi bhaari ne eziizeeze ne ebhitubha bhye ezahaabu bhiizwiiri omuruumbaaso. Omuruumbaaso guyo, nigo amasabhi ga abhahoreeru.
Bhakamweembera Engʼoondu omweembo omuhya guno gwaari gukubhuga,

content.text: abhaatu bhe eziingaanda zyoosi, ebhigaambo bhyoosi,

content: Niho nikarora no okwiigwa eriiraka rya bhamaraika bhaaru bhukongʼu, ebhikwe kwe ebhikwe, naabhe bhatakunagya kubharwa. Bhamaraika bhayo, bhaari bhiiruguuriri ekituumbi kyo omuriinga, hamwe ne ebhityeenyi na abhakaruka bharya.
Nikabhiitegeerera bhareemba kwe eriiraka ikuru, bharabhuga,

content.text: areenderwa okusuungʼaana obhunagya, obhuniibhi na amangʼeeni.
Eziinguru, obhusuuku, obhuguungo no omukumo ni bhyaaye!”

content: Hayo nikiigwa ebhigiro bhyoosi mwiisaaro, mukyaaro, nyaari na munyaanza bhireemba kwa hamwe,

content.text: bhahaanwe obhuguungo no obhunagya kirakeego na kirakeego!”

content: Ne ebhityeenyi ebhine bhirya bhyo obhuhoru bhikiitabha bhikabhuga, “Gabhe ego!” Neebho abhakaruka bharya bhakamugweera mumaguru, bhakaseengera Taatabhugya no Omwaana wa Taatabhugya.

footnotes.text: Ekisyooko kya Yuuda kirabhirikirwa endwi mu Obhweemero 49:9, no omutemi Daudi akiibhurwa mukisyooko kino, hamwe na Yeesu.
Engʼoondu. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
